## Today's learning {#iv5-objective .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson .geometric-lesson }


### Learning objective

We are learning to connect the scalar product with vector magnitudes and the angle between vectors.

### Success criterion

I can use both scalar-product formulas and explain the magnitude identity and special cases.


::: notes
The component formula from Lesson 4 and the geometric formula describe the same scalar. Students should connect them, rather than memorise two unrelated rules.
:::
